summary: Capability extension sourced from the 2026-09-09 Bilibili coaching corpus (kb-candidates 01/02/03/10/11/12/13/14/15). v10 adds eight active entries: three advice-layer ergonomics entries (desk-monitor self-check, compensatory strain behind hand pain, post-injury rehab-to-specific ramp), two community technique entries (arm-first sensitivity fitting, joint-role division and isolation), and three training-organization entries (subcategory daily rotation, benchmark diagnose-then-isolate, smoothness sweep). hypothesis.tension-management is upgraded from @4 to @5 by folding in the task-graded subjective tension scale, the two-force model, tension creep, and the rigidity-elasticity cycle while keeping its existing boundary (a cue and candidate experiment, never a measurement) and its stop rule unchanged. Twenty-seven coach_first_party sources are added for the corpus; every section claim stays at or below its source ceiling (community_practice). All eight new entries carry the candidate_experiment capability prefix and therefore a cue, dose guardrail, matched retest, and stop rule; the three ergonomics entries and every training entry's stop rule lead with the medical red line (persistent pain, numbness, or weakness stops training and is referred to a doctor or rehabilitation professional; the entries relay a coach's process and are not medical advice). Body-related content stays at the experimental candidate-hypothesis ceiling per ARCHITECTURE 4.5: no entry claims that desk setup, posture, compensation, or recovery progress is observable from Aiming Cookie input or outcome data. The schema (coach_knowledge_registry.v3), the signal_aliases map, the capability prefix ladder, all 37 v9 entry ids other than the tension upgrade, and every v9 entry_version are unchanged, and v9 remains loadable as history.

capability_discipline.body_content_ceiling: experimental candidate hypothesis; no measured or deterministic body cause is generated
capability_discipline.medical_red_line: Persistent pain, numbness, or weakness stops training immediately and is referred to a doctor or rehabilitation professional; ergonomics entries state they are process relays, not medical advice or treatment.
capability_discipline.sensitivity_rule_compatibility: community.arm-first-sensitivity-fitting.scope restates that only the current scenario's own run data supports an in-product sensitivity value, keeping coach-system.md L80 intact.

added_entries.note: Advice-layer desk/chair/monitor self-check (10-15 degree armpit angle, monitor straight ahead at eye level, forearm-pad pivot with floating wrist); trigger is user report only, never data inference.
Hand pain as a compensation signal; tuning sensitivity does not remove the transferred burden; self-check three questions; medical red line.
Post-injury descale relay (release, activation, basic motions, 0.5x specific ramp) with the medical red line in front; stated as a process relay, not medical advice.
Fit the arm range first, then the wrist/fingertip value inside it; low-sensitivity burden transfer and micro-adjustment suppression as the counter-claim.
Shoulder/arm/wrist/finger division by movement scale plus isolation via sensitivity range, scenario choice, and physical constraints; combat ratio kept as one coach's estimate.
Daily subcategory rotation with a same-subcategory scenario ban across weeks; structure example, not a dose prescription.
Benchmark diagnosis, one-skill isolation with feedback, benchmark re-run; deathmatch demoted to warm-up; scheduling schools kept side by side.

Multi-difficulty multi-sensitivity sweep to expose weak form zones with first-run-effect discount, plus the 5-10 minute weakest-category warm-up; author's doubled specialization volume explicitly not copied.

added_limitations: Scale values, graded ranges, and the two-force model are single-coach verbal heuristics without physiological measurement.
upgraded_entries.unchanged_invariants: definition, scope, expected_direction, original mechanisms, cue, original dose guardrail, matched_retest, and stop_adjust_rule are byte-identical to @4; the entry stays 'a cue and candidate experiment, not a measurement'.

audited_unchanged.note: entry_id, entry_version, and every section are carried over unchanged from v9; signal_aliases and the existing 48 sources are untouched.
schema_version stays coach_knowledge_registry.v3; both the Python and TypeScript loaders register 2026-09-09.v10 as the packaged default and keep every historical version loadable by exact version.
